steps.en: Install a TeX distribution — not this repository, which the project says is not an install source
steps.zh: 安装一个 TeX 发行版——不是本仓库，项目明确说它不是安装源

steps.en: Write a .tex file, declaring the document class and the packages you need
steps.zh: 写一个 .tex 文件，声明文档类与需要的宏包

steps.en: The LaTeX kernel loads that class and resolves every requested package
steps.zh: LaTeX 内核加载该文档类，并逐个解析所请求的宏包

steps.en: Process the file with the TeX engine your distribution ships
steps.zh: 用发行版自带的 TeX 引擎加工这个文件

steps.en: Expands the macros and typesets the document to its output format
steps.zh: 做宏展开，并把文档排成目标输出格式

value.en: Your source compiles on a stack whose language has been stable for four decades and that every journal template already targets
value.zh: 你的源文件跑在一套语言稳定了四十年、且每一份期刊模板都已适配的栈上

sources: README.md (the kernel repo is unpackaged source; building from it 'is a non-trivial exercise'; obtain LaTeX from CTAN or via TeXLive, MacTeX, MiKTeX; repo components base, doc, required: tools/graphics/amsmath/firstaid/latex-lab)
https://www.latex-project.org/get/ (distributions by OS, CTAN as the primary distribution source, 'The repository is not meant to be used as an install source for users')
https://www.latex-project.org/help/documentation/ (standard classes article, report, book; source2e; LaTeX News)
base/ltvers.dtx (\fmtversion {2026-11-01}, \patch@level {-2}; the file's own comment: a negative patch level is a candidate release that is not distributed)
NOTE: no TeX engine invocation (pdflatex/lualatex/latexmk) appears in any source read, so step 4 deliberately carries no code token.
